# How Router Renders the Components

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## How Router Renders the Components

When the URL changes, React Router unmounts the old component and mounts the new one without refreshing the page.

State components that stay mounted — like a wrapper layout — are preserved. Only the matched component changes.

This is fundamentally different from a multi-page HTML website where every link triggers a full reload.

Here, JavaScript intercepts the navigation and swaps out just the part of the tree that changed.
